hub.label: Recruitment
hub.title: A forest recruitment capital
hub.intro: A safe provincial capital that can eventually reach tier 5. The archive's capital role is a priority plan, not a verified current build order: forest-chain tiers, slot totals and recruitment access in the installed build are unverified. Check the live building preview before starting several projects.

steps.title: Repair the settlement; retain useful recruitment
steps.short: Repair the settlement; retain useful recruitment
steps.note: Do not demolish a working starting chain to make an ideal slot diagram. Fill the basic army first.

steps.title: Farmstead + Market Square
steps.short: Farmstead + Market Square
steps.note: Add growth and income as slots allow. In a cash shortage, build the affordable income improvement before another military side branch.

steps.title: Eerie Woods → Silent Grove
steps.short: Eerie Woods → Silent Grove
steps.note: The tier-3 Grove is your first major forest milestone: Things in the Woods and Hag Witch recruitment.

steps.title: Earthen Hollow → Cavern of Silk → Animal Den
steps.short: Earthen Hollow → Cavern of Silk → Animal Den
steps.note: Develop the separate animal chain only for the spiders and bears you plan to recruit. Do not confuse it with the Woods chain.

steps.title: Ostankya’s Hut, where eligible
steps.short: Ostankya’s Hut, where eligible
steps.note: Reserve its unique slot in Bleak Hold Fortress or Volksgrad. At another capital, use this space for recovery, resources or administration.

steps.title: Haunted Forest after funding the army
steps.short: Haunted Forest after funding the army
steps.note: The Woods chain’s tier-5 end supports Incarnates. Finance the buildings AND recruitment/upkeep before committing.

details: Slot plan, not six simultaneous buildings

Settlement upgrades add slots. One chain changes name as it upgrades; it does not occupy one slot per name. By the mid-game, aim for the needed Woods and animal chains, a sustainable economy and a purpose-built support slot.
Basic human recruitment

Use the live Kislevite Warriors, Kossar and Akshina recruitment options while the beasts are unavailable. Preserve useful starting infantry infrastructure. The special forest army does not require opening the entire royal Kislev roster.

hut.label: Hut
hut.title: The landmark’s home
hut.intro: Bleak Hold Fortress, or Volksgrad after a deliberate homecoming. The archive's landmark guidance is a priority plan, not a verified current build order: the Hut's effects, tier gate and current price in the installed build are unverified. Check the live landmark preview before committing the slot.

steps.title: Retain a safe, eligible landmark site
steps.short: Retain a safe, eligible landmark site
steps.note: Only one Hut landmark may stand at a time. Do not plan duplicate passive-essence farms.

steps.title: Develop growth and income before the tier-3 purchase
steps.short: Develop growth and income before the tier-3 purchase
steps.note: An elite-looking ritual economy cannot substitute for a working army. Preserve cash for replacement troops.

steps.title: Construct Ostankya’s Hut
steps.short: Construct Ostankya’s Hut
steps.note: Reference effects: +4 Essence each turn, income, cheaper Hexes and better Kislev relations. Check the actual current price.

steps.title: Provide a defending force or credible local response
steps.short: Provide a defending force or credible local response
steps.note: The passive income and Essence make the site worth keeping safe even while Ostankya travels.

steps.title: Treat Essence discounts as savings
steps.short: Treat Essence discounts as savings
steps.note: Cheaper casts conserve the wallet. They are not extra mission credit, and do not make research spending automatically qualify.

steps.title: Keep the landmark distinct from the crafting menu
steps.short: Keep the landmark distinct from the crafting menu
steps.note: You use the Witch’s Hut interface for Incantations; the landmark is a settlement building supporting that loop.

details: There is no VCO “build this Hut” shortcut
The landmark helps the campaign; it does not itself complete any of the three published VCO routes. Do not confuse a concurrent vanilla objective with your selected VCO goal.

income.label: Income
income.title: A safe town that funds the coven
income.intro: A protected settlement with no immediate defensive or ingredient-retention job. The archive's income-chain pattern is a priority order, not a verified current build order: exact effects, tiers and slot requirements in the installed build are unverified. Check the live building preview before spending an economic slot.

steps.title: Farmstead → Stud Farm → Farm Estate
steps.short: Farmstead → Stud Farm → Farm Estate
steps.note: Growth helps local development; the chain also produces income and recruitment discounts.

steps.title: Market Square → Merchant Traders → Trade Quorum
steps.short: Market Square → Merchant Traders → Trade Quorum
steps.note: A straightforward income chain for ordinary settlements. The three great Kislev cities use their own market branch.

steps.title: Build the resource chain, if one exists
steps.short: Build the resource chain, if one exists
steps.note: Unique local resources can justify replacing a generic slot; inspect actual trade demand and income.

steps.title: Add Hallowed Wood when farms or recovery justify it
steps.short: Add Hallowed Wood when farms or recovery justify it
steps.note: Its recovery is regional. A farming multiplier must repay the cost of the slot as well as construction.

steps.title: Add Court / Orthodoxy infrastructure for a need
steps.short: Add Court / Orthodoxy infrastructure for a need
steps.note: Use a Courthouse or Orthodoxy branch where Devotion or support is a real bottleneck. Avoid changing every town into a temple complex.

steps.title: Retire growth only after the province is developed
steps.short: Retire growth only after the province is developed
steps.note: Roadhouse is a more natural temporary growth investment; a mature farm still earns income. Compare replacements rather than demolishing all farms.

details: Not an empire-wide factory recipe
A safe town can be simple: farm, market and its best local resource or support building. A port is valuable where available; additional buildings depend on the settlement’s actual slots.
Great cities are exceptions
Kislev, Praag and Erengrad have special chains and wider slot plans. This ordinary-town recipe is not a literal blueprint for those three cities.

recovery.label: Recovery
recovery.title: A regional recovery station
recovery.intro: Place it where your expedition will really end turns. The archive's recovery pattern is a priority plan, not a verified current build order: the Hallowed chain's effects, tiers and regional scope in the installed build are unverified. Check the live building preview before spending the slot.

steps.title: Secure the region before constructing
steps.short: Secure the region before constructing
steps.note: A half-built recovery chain in a town you cannot defend is not logistics.

steps.title: Hallowed Wood → Hallowed Weald → Hallowed Forest
steps.short: Hallowed Wood → Hallowed Weald → Hallowed Forest
steps.note: The replenishment chain is separate from Haunted Forest. Use the actual region containing it.

steps.title: Farm + basic income
steps.short: Farm + basic income
steps.note: A station needs to pay part of its own upkeep. Local farm recruitment discounts help only when you recruit there.

steps.title: Stabilise Devotion and clear corruption
steps.short: Stabilise Devotion and clear corruption
steps.note: Purification solves corruption/plague problems; it does not automatically raise provincial Devotion.

steps.title: Add defence on a contested approach
steps.short: Add defence on a contested approach
steps.note: Use the settlement’s appropriate garrison chain and keep a nearby response force where the threat warrants one.

steps.title: Add one forward recruiting branch only if needed
steps.short: Add one forward recruiting branch only if needed
steps.note: A Grove or human recruiting chain may avoid a long march home. Do not reproduce the entire capital here.

details: Replenishment is not a universal province aura
The Hallowed chain’s recovery effect is tied to its region in the checked database. Park the army correctly and inspect its next-turn recovery arrows; proximity on the map is not enough.
Avoid imaginary healing
A Hag’s Protective Charms helps attrition, not battle losses. Use Convalescence, the lord’s recovery skills and a valid local recovery position; add a Patriarch only when recruitable.

resource.label: Resources
resource.title: A protected resource and trade node
resource.intro: Use natural advantages instead of forcing every settlement into one recipe. The archive's resource role is a priority plan, not a verified current build order: chain effects, tiers and slot requirements in the installed build are unverified. Check the live building preview before spending a slot.

steps.title: Repair and inspect its local resource
steps.short: Repair and inspect its local resource
steps.note: A rare resource or strong port can matter more than the generic market slot. Decide whether you can hold it.

steps.title: Develop the resource chain and port where present
steps.short: Develop the resource chain and port where present
steps.note: Base the next upgrade on its actual income, tradable output and your trading partners.

steps.title: Market income; growth while still developing
steps.short: Market income; growth while still developing
steps.note: Add a market and temporary growth as slots and the local benefit justify them.

steps.title: Stabilise Devotion before a large climate-sensitive spend
steps.short: Stabilise Devotion before a large climate-sensitive spend
steps.note: A temporary good number is not permanent climate immunity. Watch the trend and nearby hostile corruption.

steps.title: Use Ambassador on a secure commercial province
steps.short: Use Ambassador on a secure commercial province
steps.note: The rank-12 governor choice suits resources and diplomacy; Warden is the alternative for an active danger zone.

steps.title: Protect the trade and the approach
steps.short: Protect the trade and the approach
steps.note: A small response force or a better diplomatic border may protect more value than another low-return income upgrade.

details: Ostankya’s resource interest
The faction has additional magical value from resource development in the checked faction data. It is a nice synergy, not a reason to occupy every resource on the map.
Development still has an opportunity cost
Money spent on a distant port cannot simultaneously replace losses in your main army. Check payback and likely ownership duration.

frontier.label: Frontier
frontier.title: A border or coast worth holding
frontier.intro: A settlement on a real enemy approach, not every location with a shoreline. The archive's frontier guidance is a priority pattern, not a verified current build order: garrison chains, tiers and costs in the installed build are unverified. Check the live building preview before founding a grand economy.

steps.title: Repair; inspect the enemy’s actual reach
steps.short: Repair; inspect the enemy’s actual reach
steps.note: Keep reserve cash for immediate recruitment if an attack is likely before a building completes.

steps.title: Palisade → Stanitsa Defences in minor towns
steps.short: Palisade → Stanitsa Defences in minor towns
steps.note: Adds a defended unwalled settlement battle, Devotion and garrison strength. Do not assume it gives city walls.

steps.title: Use the capital’s own defensive chain there
steps.short: Use the capital’s own defensive chain there
steps.note: A provincial capital does not use the identical minor-town recipe. Upgrade the actual chain in its menu.

steps.title: Hallowed recovery + Devotion support
steps.short: Hallowed recovery + Devotion support
steps.note: A forward army should have a place to recover, not simply a garrison waiting for its next siege.

steps.title: Assign a Warden Ataman when useful
steps.short: Assign a Warden Ataman when useful
steps.note: A governor can support the frontier and enable regional garrison sallies. Check the displayed radius and preview.

steps.title: Convert to income when the frontier moves
steps.short: Convert to income when the frontier moves
steps.note: Once the approach is protected by another secure province, stop overinvesting in yesterday’s border.

details: Do not build for every hypothetical attack
A fortified town without an affordable response army can still fall to a major enemy stack. Defend a coherent corridor and scout the next approach.
Autoresolve and sallies
Use the same casualty discipline for a garrison sally as for a field battle. Losing the garrison to an avoidable win can make the next attack worse.

temporary.label: Temporary
temporary.title: A gain with an exit plan
temporary.intro: Captured for cash, movement, safety or a temporary replenishment stop. The archive's temporary-holding guidance is a retention plan, not a verified current build order: repair values, trading rules and credit behaviour in the installed build are unverified. Check the live options before promising a buffer.

steps.title: Check whether the route needs continued ownership
steps.short: Check whether the route needs continued ownership
steps.note: Never classify a Route II ingredient site as temporary until its actual control requirement is resolved.

steps.title: Keep useful repairs cheap
steps.short: Keep useful repairs cheap
steps.note: Repair what buys the next few turns. Do not queue elite recruitment for a town you intend to leave.

steps.title: Take the immediate strategic benefit
steps.short: Take the immediate strategic benefit
steps.note: Use the staging position, remove the enemy’s recruitment or obtain the verified settlement-action credit.

steps.title: Decide the recipient before promising a buffer
steps.short: Decide the recipient before promising a buffer
steps.note: Vanilla settlement trading has restrictions. Trade Any Settlement is an optional convenience, not a required mod or assumed installed capability.

steps.title: Transfer, leave or develop intentionally
steps.short: Transfer, leave or develop intentionally
steps.note: Choose based on the route and the live diplomatic options. A new conquest is not automatically a permanent responsibility.

steps.title: Reassess if the operation changes
steps.short: Reassess if the operation changes
steps.note: A temporary port can become a useful long-term hub. Adapt to the objective, not an arbitrary territorial limit.

details: Do not confuse a ruined enemy town with a safe flank
Destroying a settlement may remove its income, but an enemy army can still exist nearby. Scout and check faction elimination independently.

field.label: Field station
field.title: A Lustrian collecting station
field.intro: A required-site holding with a clear retention job, not a disposable raid. The archive's collecting-station role is a priority plan, not a verified current rule: the ingredient quota and live credit behaviour in the installed build are unverified. Verify the objective panel before committing to a whole war.

steps.title: Choose the site for the ingredient quota
steps.short: Choose the site for the ingredient quota
steps.note: Record its group and current controller. The current public guide omits the quota; the ledger’s three-per-group default is explicitly archival.

steps.title: Occupy and check live objective credit
steps.short: Occupy and check live objective credit
steps.note: Do not invent a hero “search” action. The archived mission uses direct control; verify after the first action before committing to a whole war.

steps.title: Repair; add regional recovery
steps.short: Repair; add regional recovery
steps.note: Hallowed Wood and affordable income make the site a useful expedition stop.

steps.title: Raise provincial Devotion for the local climate
steps.short: Raise provincial Devotion for the local climate
steps.note: Devotion of 75+ neutralises climate penalties in the rework. Plan to keep that threshold rather than immediately spending it on invocations.

steps.title: Defend the route between credited sites
steps.short: Defend the route between credited sites
steps.note: Use an escort army or a protected border. A distant ally is not assumed to satisfy an ownership requirement.

steps.title: Hold credited locations until the route is awarded
steps.short: Hold credited locations until the route is awarded
steps.note: Do not sell a required station because you visited it once. After confirmed victory, choose the next route before disposing of it.

details: Selection is flexible; requirements are not invented

Each ingredient group has six candidate sites. Under the public archived implementation, three controlled sites from each group suffice. The modern author guide does not prove that this exact quota still applies; verify the live panel and edit the ledger’s quotas if necessary.
Retain a coherent collecting corridor
Pick connected holdings and manageable current owners. Three easier sites may be better than attacking a powerful Lizardman capital simply because it is first in the list.

reclaim.label: Reclaimed
reclaim.title: A newly secured northern province
reclaim.intro: Convert conquest into a sustainable realm after eliminating the nearby threat. The archive's reclaimed-province pattern is a priority plan, not a verified current build order: chain effects, tiers and slot requirements in the installed build are unverified. Check the live building preview before overbuilding.

steps.title: Finish the local enemy before overbuilding
steps.short: Finish the local enemy before overbuilding
steps.note: A faction with a surviving stack behind you can undo expensive construction.

steps.title: Repair income and resource buildings first
steps.short: Repair income and resource buildings first
steps.note: Keep useful inherited functions; avoid a complete rebuild merely for visual uniformity.

steps.title: Hallowed recovery + provincial Devotion
steps.short: Hallowed recovery + provincial Devotion
steps.note: Clear corruption and create a reliable turn-ending region. Corruption and Devotion need separate attention.

steps.title: Choose one capital as the next recruitment hub
steps.short: Choose one capital as the next recruitment hub
steps.note: A wider kingdom needs regional replacement capacity, not every settlement recruiting everything.

steps.title: Fortify the exposed approach; assign a governor
steps.short: Fortify the exposed approach; assign a governor
steps.note: Warden fits the active front. Once it becomes interior territory, an economic assignment may be better.

steps.title: Hand over surplus territory only after checking credit
steps.short: Hand over surplus territory only after checking credit
steps.note: The 32-settlement objective is an action counter, not an ownership quota. Retain what helps the next war; do not discard a useful base just to stay small.

details: Wide when it serves the war
The New Frontier needs repeated operations across Naggaroth. Additional income and recruiting centres can be sensible. No province ceiling applies to this plan.
